caption: The drawing features six stylized floral motifs arranged across a plain, light beige background. The motifs are composed of simple, rounded shapes and scalloped edges, utilizing a palette that includes yellow, red, dark blue, green, light blue, brown, and beige. The upper left motif has two small red buds and blue leaves with a central yellow flower. The upper center motif includes a yellow flower, a blue-and-red flower, and a blue-and-yellow flower. The upper right motif consists of a large blue petal with a yellow detail and an adjoining red-tipped floral element. On the left side, a brown and beige stem with attached leaves supports a red and brown flower. The central motif contains beige, pink, and yellow leaves with small blue and yellow flowers. The lower motif has a beige and brown stem with red and pink leaves, leading to a green and yellow flower with circular center detailing. The outline of the lines and shapes is clear, with distinct color blocks for each part of the motifs. The artist's note, written in brown at the bottom right corner, reads: "DETAIL MOTIFS - PLATE #3 M.C. CHAPLIN - PARIS."
title: Design from a Proposed Portfolio
